data.title: Medicare is using AI to approve claims. The result has been ‘alarmingly high denial rates.’
data.summary_raw: A pilot program using artificial intelligence to approve care for Medicare beneficiaries has resulted in high levels of denials and delayed decisions and prompted warnings from a vendor about a lack of readiness, according to a lawsuit seeking information about the program.
